# Nykst

> Nykst maps a software repository and shows what a code change will affect before it is made. It reads real files and imports, follows SQL migrations, OpenAPI operations and gRPC methods, and puts a file and line behind every answer. GitHub access is read-only.

Nykst is a web application for developers and teams. Connect GitHub, choose a repository, and build a six-level map from organization to file. The same evidence is available to coding assistants through eleven read-only MCP tools.

## Product

- [Live system map](https://nykst.unifies.codes/graph): Open a repository as a map of files, services, database tables and the routes a change will reach.
- [System memory](https://nykst.unifies.codes/intelligence): Keep architecture decisions, incidents and team conventions attached to the code they explain.
- [Plans and access](https://nykst.unifies.codes/subscribe): Start a 7-day trial. Monthly and annual pricing include 18% GST.
- [Docs](https://nykst.unifies.codes/docs): Connect a repository, read the map and set up a coding assistant.

## Guides

- [How to read a change impact proof](https://nykst.unifies.codes/guides/read-impact-proof): Importers, runtime dependents, entrypoints and covering checks.
- [How SQL column and migration impact works](https://nykst.unifies.codes/guides/sql-migration-impact): What static migration analysis can prove and what it cannot.
- [How to use the read-only MCP tools safely](https://nykst.unifies.codes/guides/mcp-read-only): Token scope, read-only guarantees and revocation.
- [Connect an MCP client](https://nykst.unifies.codes/mcp): Setup for Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Codex, Windsurf, Gemini CLI, Cline and Zed.

## Trust and limits

- [Privacy](https://nykst.unifies.codes/privacy): What Nykst reads, stores and retains. Nykst does not train on connected code.
- [Limits](https://nykst.unifies.codes/limits): Repository size, file size, language and contract coverage.
- [Status](https://nykst.unifies.codes/status): Website, API, billing setup and database health.
- [Source](https://github.com/flawsom/nykst): Public GitHub repository.

## For agents

- [MCP tool schema](https://nykst.unifies.codes/api/mcp/schema): Public JSON schema for eleven read-only tools.
- [Health endpoint](https://nykst.unifies.codes/api/health): Current service and configuration status.
